about.title: About Hometown Smiles Dentistry
text: Welcome to Hometown Smiles Dentistry! We’re dedicated to providing exceptional dental care for your entire family in a warm, friendly, and comfortable environment. Led by the experienced and compassionate Dr. Ng, our team is here to ensure that your first visit is a pleasant and stress-free experience.

Dr. Christopher Ng, DDS, earned his Doctor of Dental Surgery at UT Health San Antonio School of Dentistry and is a Fellow of the International Congress of Oral Implantologists (ICOI). He is committed to providing exceptional dental care in a comforting and soothing environment. He believes that addressing oral health issues can enhance overall health, leading to a higher quality of life. With a focus on comprehensive treatment planning, Dr. Ng strives to empower patients with strategies to preserve their dental health for a lifetime.
As a lifelong learner, Dr. Ng dedicates countless hours to advanced education and explores new technologies to ensure that every patient receives care that surpasses expectations.
